youtube.title: Why Paper Cuts Hurt So Much 📄 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
A paper cut hurts out of proportion to its size because it usually happens on the fingertips, which are packed with nerve endings. The edge of paper is microscopically rough, so it tears skin rather than slicing it cleanly. The cut is also shallow, so it often barely bleeds and leaves exposed nerve endings unprotected every time you touch or bend your finger.
